name: Forliazco
backstory: Child of Trezco and Forliamus; grew up around settles the house's accounts at the market stalls... in Terfila, and knows something of Salthos Mediator Line.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Farlo and Tamuken now have a child, Farmuken.
Heard that Trezco and Tamuken now have a child, Tamuzco.
Heard that Forliamus and Farlo now have a child, Forliarlo.
Had a child with Tamuken, named Forliuken.
Had a child with Farlo, named Farliazco.
Had a child with Farmuken, named Forliamuk.
Heard that Forliarlo and Forliuken now have a child, Forliukar.
Heard that Farlo and Trezco now have a child, Trezarlo.
Heard that Farliazco and Forliukar now have a child, Farliukar.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliauzco.
Heard that Forliauzco and Forliamuk now have a child, Forliauken.
Heard that Tamuzco and Forliamuk now have a child, Tamuzaken.
Heard that Trezarlo and Forliukar now have a child, Trezukar.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Forliuzazco.
Heard that Tamuzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliuzco.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Forliamus Betrothal Offer
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Forliamus Betrothal Offer
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes to the transit route himself now when a ship idles too long in port, and finds he still slows near the temple without quite meaning to.

arc.premise: Forliazco, Forliamus's own child, wants the house's betrothal offer answered outright - sealed or refused - and means to find whichever go-between will actually carry a reply back instead of letting it drift the way the family's last one did.
